name: usage-forecast
description: Gauges for context, 5-hour and weekly usage: boxes that fill, a percentage, green/yellow/red, and a pace forecast.

contextWarnAt.title: Context: yellow at (%)
contextWarnAt.description: Context window fill that turns the gauge yellow.

contextDangerAt.title: Context: red at (%)
contextDangerAt.description: Context window fill that turns the gauge red.

limitWarnAt.title: Limits: yellow at (%)
limitWarnAt.description: 5-hour or weekly use that turns the gauge yellow.

limitDangerAt.title: Limits: red at (%)
limitDangerAt.description: 5-hour or weekly use that turns the gauge red.

glyphs.title: Box style
glyphs.description: boxes draws ■□, blocks draws █░ (pick blocks if ■ looks off in your font).

band.title: One-line band above the prompt
band.description: Also draw a compact one-line gauge row above the prompt (terminal and desktop).

alerts.title: Toast when a gauge turns yellow or red
alerts.description: Show a one-line toast once per window when a gauge crosses into yellow or red.
